No. 155
Date 8/3/26

Shanghai Municipal Council.

March 8th 1926

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH.)

Sir,
    A Cantonese named Daung Chi Sing 唐桂星 who is
alleged to be a rebel leader, was arrested in Tien Pao
Li 天宝里 alleyway, Churei yesterday morning. He was
sent by boat to the Arsenal at 11 a.m. under the escort
of eight armed soldiers.
    In consequence of a telegram from Poking urging him to
hurry up with the manufacture of munitions, the Director of
the Arsenal has engaged thirty additional workers.
    It is said that the operatives at the Arsenal have
asked for an increase of wages and that they will go on
strike if their request is refused.
    The rebels in Shanghai have sent one of their party
named Dan Er Soo 譚二叔 to Honan to investigate the
situation there.
    It is reported that the rebels here, having lost faith
in Chon Chi Moi 陈其美 have elected Nyeu Tih Sung 鈕鐵生
as their leader. Nyeu is expected to arrive soon
by a Japanese boat.
    The shipping companies are arranging to employ
watchmen to guard the jetties on the Chinese Bund.
These watchmen will be supervised by the City Police.

                Your Obedient Servant,

                [Signature]

                Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

Seen by C.S.P.
Entered on M.I. March 8

刑事调查处
情报官登记
编号 155
日期 26年3月8日

上海工部局。

1926年3月8日

（印：上海工部局警务处）
警务处，
（侦探股。）

先生：
    一名名叫唐桂星（Daung Chi Sing）的广东人，据称是叛军首领，于昨日早晨在闸北天宝里弄堂被捕。上午11时，他在八名武装士兵的押送下，乘船被送往兵工厂。
    由于收到来自北京（Poking）的电报，催促其加快军火制造，兵工厂总监已增聘三十名工人。
    据悉，兵工厂的工人要求增加工资，并称如果要求被拒，他们将举行罢工。
    上海的叛军已派遣其党羽中的一名名叫譚二叔（Dan Er Soo）的人前往河南，以调查当地局势。
    有报告称，此地的叛军因对陈其美（Chon Chi Moi）失去信心，已选举鈕鐵生（Nyeu Tih Sung）为其首领。预计鈕鐵生将很快乘坐日本轮船抵达。
    各轮船公司正安排雇用看守人员，以守卫华界外滩的码头。这些看守人员将由华界警察监管。

                您顺从的仆人，

                [签名]

                总探长。

警务处总监。

警务处总监阅。
3月8日录入情报档案
